verification.method: Official ElevenLabs documentation (composition plans guide, music quickstart, Eleven Music API page, elevenlabs/skills api_reference.md) read 2026-09-16. The API surface is verified; the web-app (ElevenCreative) form is not, so the web paste path is marked partial.
verified: music_v2 is the default model; composition plans are chunk-based and require model_id='music_v2'; music_v1 plans use positive_global_styles / negative_global_styles / sections (legacy)

A composition plan is an ordered list of up to 30 chunks; each GenerationChunk has text, duration_ms, positive_styles, negative_styles, context_adherence, and optional conditioning_ref + condition_strength; AudioRefChunk references audio
The first chunk's styles set the overall tone and genre for the whole song

Chunk text grammar: section name in [square brackets], lyrics as plain lines separated by \n, phonetic sounds in (parentheses), short inline directions in {curly braces}; broad characteristics go in positive_styles
Styles must be English (lyrics any language); up to 50 style qualities; use negative styles liberally
Composition plans and text prompts are mutually exclusive per request
music_length_ms from 3,000 to 600,000; sections 3 s to 2 min each (API marketing page)
Artist/band names or copyrighted lyrics return bad_prompt / bad_composition_plan with a suggested replacement
In-painting via source_from in composition plans exists; enterprise-only as of 2026-08
Cleared for broad commercial use; licensed training (press and docs)
unverified: Web-app field set, labels and character limits (prompt box, instrumental toggle, length picker, plan editor)
Whether the web app exposes chunk-level editing of a pasted plan
force_instrumental parameter name on v2 (v1-era name; confirm)
Whether chunks under 3,000 ms are rejected or clamped

fields.label: Prompt (simple mode)
fields.notes: One-shot mode; mutually exclusive with composition_plan. Used for the web-app paste and for quick auditions. Same priority order as Suno Style; negatives inline ('instrumental only, no vocals').

fields.label: Composition plan (music_v2)
fields.notes: Primary EVAWAVE target for this engine. {"chunks": [GenerationChunk...]}, ≤30 chunks. One chunk per Section; duration_ms = bars × barSec rounded; contrast phrases become their own chunk; pickups and silence drops fold into the preceding chunk's text as {inline directions}. First chunk positive_styles carries the song-wide palette and the meter lock; every chunk's negative_styles carries the negative-space classes.

fields.label: Length (ms)
fields.notes: 3,000–600,000. Written from Structure.derived.runtimeSec × 1000; must equal the sum of chunk durations when a plan is used.

fields.label: Model
fields.notes: 'music_v2' for chunk plans. Never 'music_v1' from EVAWAVE.

fields.label: Instrumental
fields.notes: v1-era parameter name; verify on v2. In plans, instrumental sections also carry {instrumental break} and negative 'lead vocals'.

toggles.label: Instrumental
toggles.effect: Web-app toggle (label unverified). API: force_instrumental (verify on v2).

options.note: Default; chunk-based composition plans, mid-track transitions, embedded SFX
Legacy; global styles + sections plan shape. Not targeted by EVAWAVE.

driftWordsNote: Inherited from the Suno v6 list; untested on music_v2. Chunk duration_ms enforces timing independently of prose, so meter drift is expected to be less damaging here; take logs decide.
bannedTermsNote: The API rejects artist/band names and copyrighted lyrics with bad_prompt / bad_composition_plan and returns a suggestion (verified docs 2026-09-16). EVAWAVE's lineage pass strips names before serialization; a rejection still reaching the user is a lineage-pass bug.
aliasesNote: Inherited from the Suno profile; re-verify per engine from take logs.
weightingNote: Verified for plans: the first chunk's styles set the whole song's tone. Unknown for the simple prompt.

supportsNotes.D3: Per-chunk styles and durations give section-level dynamics control.
supportsNotes.D6: No numeric BPM field; tempo as a style term. Chunk duration_ms gives exact section timing, which is the strongest grid control of the three engines. Key/mode as prose.
supportsNotes.D7: Chunks map 1:1 to Sections with real durations; ≤30 chunks; chunk minimum 3 s means pickups and silence fold inline.
supportsNotes.D8: Lyrics per chunk in text; phonetic (ooh) and inline {directions} supported.
supportsNotes.D9: Mix character as style terms only.
supportsNotes.D10: negative_styles per chunk; first chunk acts as global.

houseBudgetsNote: Engine cap is 50 qualities; house cap 20 keeps the first chunk readable and ordered.
postRender: In-painting (source_from) regenerates one chunk while keeping the rest; enterprise-only as of 2026-08, so not assumed in the v1 workflow.
Downloads within plan limits; commercial use cleared under Eleven's music terms.
For DAW handoff, chunk durations already match the word-MIDI blueprint bar map; export the plan JSON alongside the stems.

repairRules.action: A name or lyric slipped past the lineage pass; diff the payload against the API's suggestion, fix the offending term in the IR (not in the payload), recompile.
Check that music_length_ms equals the sum of chunk duration_ms; recompute from bar math; do not hand-edit durations.

repairRules.symptom: vocals appear in an instrumental chunk
repairRules.action: Add {instrumental break} to the chunk text and 'lead vocals, singing' to that chunk's negative_styles; set force_instrumental if the whole track is instrumental.

exports.content: simple-mode prompt for the web app

notes: Two artifacts per compile: the plan JSON (primary, API or plan editor) and the simple prompt (web-app paste). The coverage report is computed against the plan.
AudioRefChunk and conditioning_ref are deliberately unused in v1: they would require uploading reference audio, which A6 forbids.
Litigation state 2026-09-16 (data only, per A12): licensed training, created with labels and publishers; no known suits.
